description: How seasonal circulation, cross-equatorial winds, tropical convection, moisture convergence and regional geography create monsoons, with South Asian, West African and North American case studies.

related_resources.reason: Regional seasonal wind shift, North American moisture and topographic influences.
Column water budgets, rainfall intensification, aerosol influence on tropical rain belts and monsoons.
Regional monsoon climate evidence, attribution and qualified future projections.
South Asian monsoon geography, mountains, precipitation seasonality and regional climate context.

Tropical convergence belt, seasonal migration, atmospheric energy balance.
Atmospheric water vapor flux convergence and rainfall budget.

historical_claims.anchor: The South Asian monsoon gives this feedback

background: Introduces pressure, moisture transport and latent heat before comparing the three distinct monsoon regions.

Why does higher humidity not guarantee higher rainfall?
